_readme: Curated show tags applied by scripts/fetch-events.js at ingest time.
Each matched event gets a `tags: [...]` array in events.json, and the
WP plugin's [comedy_houston tag="..."] shortcode filters on it — one
mechanism for every curated landing page (black-comedy, en-espanol, ...).
HOW TAGS ARE ASSIGNED (all auto-apply, opt-out model):
1. title_rules    — case-insensitive substring match on the event title
(AFTER mojibake repair, so match clean text).
2. comedian_rules — substring match of a comedian's name in the title.
3. The model      — new show names are classified once by OpenAI
(scripts/lib/classify-show-tags.js) and cached in
config/show-tags-cache.json.
4. exclusions     — ALWAYS WIN. The false-positive kill switch.
TO REMOVE A WRONGLY TAGGED SHOW (the weekly 2-minute review):
Add an entry to `exclusions` with a distinctive substring of the show
title and the tag(s) to strip, e.g.:
{ "contains": "midnight dirty show", "tags": ["black-comedy"] }
Commit to main (the GitHub web editor is fine) — the next twice-daily
import applies it. Use ["*"] to strip every tag from a show.
Tags in use:
black-comedy — /black-comedy-shows-houston/
en-espanol   — /spanish-comedy-houston/
kreyol       — Haitian Creole shows
